fee_notes: Royalty is a sliding scale: 10% on annual Gross Sales up to $250,000 (First Tier), 9% on $250,001–$500,000 (Second Tier), 8% on amounts above $500,000 (Third Tier). Reduced rates available under Industry Associate Program (5%/4%/3% for First/Second/Third Tier respectively for first lawn care season). Regional Advertising Fee of up to 2% of Gross Sales currently not collected. Technology Fee is $260/month base plus individual license costs ($17/user/month for Office Online License or $32/user/month for Full Office License; minimum one Full Office License required). Advertising Fund Contributions of 2% of Gross Sales paid weekly. Various other fees include: National Advisory Council Assessment Fee $20/month April–November; Education Fee $210/year; Call Center Services $200–$2,000/month; Equipment Lease $496–$688/month (optional); Transfer Fee 2.5% of trailing 12-month Gross Sales, min $7,500 max $17,500; Insufficient Funds $100; Failure to Report $25; National/Regional Meeting Fee $650 plus expenses; Customer Survey Fee $1.50–$2.00 per customer. Many fees subject to up to 100% annual Fee Adjustment.
